purpose: National base-rate measurement for a distance-broadened geometry fallback.

ruleCompared.legacy: radarScore >= 90; sun 5..22 deg; rain distance <= 15 km; observer dry
ruleCompared.candidateRules: radarScore >= threshold; sun 5..22 deg; rain distance <= 40 km; observer dry
ruleCompared.newDefinition: candidate rule passes and legacy rule fails

interpretationGuard: Radar-only upper bound, not predicted published-candidate volume. Sunlight enrichment can remove the fallback need or reject the candidate.
